author: IGN
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Brawlhalla  x DreamWorks Animation’s Shrek crossover event. Ubisoft, in collaboration with Universal Products & Experiences, announced the crossover event launching on July 29. This collaboration brings the films’ unforgettable characters—Shrek, Fiona, and Puss in Boots—from the beloved franchise to  Brawlhalla as playable characters, with Donkey as a Companion. The event will also include a Map featuring Shrek’s iconic Swamp and other items inspired by fairy tale creatures. Additional details on the crossover and those other Items will be shared at a later date. The Brawlhalla  x Shrek crossover event is launching on July 29.
title: Brawlhalla x DreamWorks Animation Shrek - Official Crossover Event Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: Toy Story revolutionized filmmaking in 1995, becoming the first ever completely computer generated feature film. But more than that, it ushered in the great Pixar era of storytelling, where grown-up and often heartbreaking themes find their way into what present as kids stuff. The combination of slapstick fantasy with grounded emotional relevance has served that adorable lamp company well in the decades since, and nowhere is it more evident than Toy Story. Going on a fifth film (even though a lot of people would've been fine if it ended with a trilogy) a lot has happened to Woody, Buzz Lightyear and the gang across four movies. Luckily, you've got a friend in me, and I've got a recap for you! Here's all the Andy, Bonnie, destructive neighbors, claw-obsessed aliens, villainous teddy bears and spooky voiceless dolls you need to know, to catch up before Toy Story 5.
title: How The Series Keeps Ending (And Coming Back Anyway) | Toy Story Franchise Recap

author: IGN
description: You are the terror that lurks amongst the shadows. Take a look at the My Cannibal Family announcement trailer for this upcoming grotesque monster horror sim with co-op multiplayer for up to 4 players. Build a twisted theme park, then use traps and stealthy attacks to harvest guests within a deadly sandbox of your own creation! My Cannibal Family will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in 2027.
title: My Cannibal Family - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: Virtue? That’s for suckers. But fame? Priceless. Watch the latest Happy Bastards trailer to see gameplay from this upcoming open-world tactical RPG. Assemble unruly bastards into a mercenary squad and build your legend through reckless adventuring, bloody fights, lucrative looting, and dirty dealings. Choose your battles, and your allies, in this irreverent open-world tactical RPG. Happy Bastards will be available on PC. A combat demo is out now on Steam.
title: Happy Bastards - Official Combat Demo Launch Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the Announcement Trailer for Freeline, a stylized third-person parkour platformer developed by Piers. Players will embody Corrin, a spirited young cat on a mission to take down his city's corporate surveillance state and reclaim the rooftops. Freeline is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Freeline - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description: Check out the Slap Out of It! announcement trailer for this upcoming slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms in all directions. Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets. Meet strange characters and solve (or add to) their problems with a personal touch. The power to change everything is in your hands. Slap Out of It! will be available on PC and Consoles in 2027.
title: Slap Out Of It! - Official Announcement Trailer
